pages.title: Cryogenic Lander
pages.text: A capsule wrapped in aerogel under a nylon parachute, its oxygen sealed in. Titan's air is so thick and its gravity so weak that a parachute alone brings you down at walking pace - Huygens took two and a half hours to land.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Reticular Chemistry.
